hypotheses.R0_pca_result_survives_coverage_control: Using only predicates with adequate positives and negatives on every corpus, PCA-mode median AUROC remains at least 0.70 everywhere.
hypotheses.R1_ica_improves_individual_semantics: ICA improves median AUROC over PCA by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_ica_is_privileged_over_random_rotatio: ICA exceeds the 95th percentile of matched whitened random rotations by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_varimax_improves_individual_semantics: Varimax improves median AUROC over PCA by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_ica_coordinates_are_reproducible: The selected ICA solution has mean greedy absolute-axis overlap at least 0.80 with every other start.
hypotheses.R5_sparse_basis_labels_are_diverse: The better sparse basis selects at least five distinct robust predicates.
